Container.Name: snsdl
Container.Overview: Self-hosted web UI for yt-dlp: paste a link, pick a quality, download on your LAN; also audio, playlists, subscriptions, live streams and photo posts. Intended for a trusted LAN only: there are no accounts, only an optional access PIN.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Host port for the web UI

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Downloads, settings and cookies; the container takes ownership with PUID:PGID

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User id the app runs as (99 = nobody)

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group id the app runs as (100 = users)

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Timezone for the nightly cleanup, e.g. Europe/London

Config.Name: Access PIN
Config.Description: Optional PIN the page asks for, 4 to 64 characters without spaces; empty = open

Config.Name: KEEP_DIR
Config.Description: Optional: set to /keep together with the Kept files path below to move kept downloads into a library folder

Config.Name: Kept files
Config.Description: Optional library folder for kept files (set KEEP_DIR=/keep as well)
